variance.cap_note: between_culture uses the default cap of 40,000; between_culture_cap400k raises the cap to the value run_extra.py uses for the founder-scaling sweep. The second is the one to plan with, because subsampling at the default cap thins the subclones the variance depends on.

n_recovered_components.note: COMPETENT = 0.50 is the share descended from recorder-carrying competent progenitors. It is a third multiplier on top of nuclei and recovery, and is stated here so that a figure like '15,500 nuclei at 60 per cent recovery give about 4,650' cannot be read as the whole calculation.

exact_tree.note: Six seeds. The pseudoreplication factor is stable across them; the maximum subclone is not, and should not be compared against a single measured clone size.

editing_rate.note: Choi et al. 2022 report about two edits per cell division across 13 DNA Array arrays in HEK293T, which is 0.15 per array per division. The model's q = 0.18 is that quantity, not a population edited fraction.

channel_dynamic_range.note: measured fold-change of stimulated over unstimulated writing for the three ENGRAM channels reported in Chen et al. 2024

division_independent.note: dual-AAV prime editing in mouse brain, three weeks after injection, including postmitotic cortical neurons

founder_scaling.note: slope near -1 means the culture-to-culture variance is set by the number of independently recording founder lineages

sweep.variant: 20 per cent, cycling at the main rate
20 per cent, 10 per cent symmetric proliferative

expanding_alternative.description: a late compartment that keeps the main fate probabilities and switches 80 days later, rather than dividing asymmetrically

alphabet_ceiling.law: ceiling = e (A - 1) / (c u), floor = 1 - exp(-N_w u / (A - 1))
alphabet_ceiling.note: the ceiling is linear in alphabet size minus one, so a design with a single shared landmark symbol has a ceiling six times lower than one with a distinguishable symbol per pulse

diagnostics.note: a single binary observable gives one operating point, not a curve, so a receiver operating characteristic would be a single point plus the two trivial corners; sensitivity, specificity and the positive likelihood ratio are the informative summaries

power_curves_normal.note: two-sided alpha 0.05, 80 per cent power, comparing net mark rates between two arms

power_curves_t.note: two-sided alpha 0.05, 80 per cent power, two-sample t on culture-level mark rates with 2(k-1) degrees of freedom, solved exactly against the noncentral t. One culture per arm has no test. The _sd_low and _sd_high fields carry the chi-squared interval on sigma_between.

readers.note: Mutual information in bits per recovered cell about a binary exposure, for three observables of the same simulated arrays. Miller-Madow corrected; the permutation floor is the residual estimation bias after shuffling condition labels and is the scale a gain must be judged against.

silencing.note: writing rate multiplied by 2**(-t/half-life). The direction is obvious; this is the size.

death.note: per-day hazard on post-mitotic cells. 'early_biased' applies only to cells that left the cycle before death_split, the case whose direction is not obvious in advance.

ipc.note: a fraction of the daughters that would have left the cycle instead divide ipc_rounds further times on a 0.6-fold cycle. pp_start is bisected to restore the reference expansion, because the compartment adds cells.

position_efficiency.note: write probability at monomer s scaled by 2**(-s/half-life). One of the two mechanisms that penalise array length.

multiplicity.note: Welch two-sample t on seed-averaged gradients, each arm against the same reference, fifty populations per arm. Holm-Bonferroni controls the family-wise error rate over the eleven arms; Benjamini-Hochberg controls the false discovery rate. mde_80 is the figure's own power-based rule, which is stricter than uncorrected significance because it requires |t| > 2.80 rather than 1.96.

gliogenesis_switched.description: the glial compartment switched on at a gliogenic transition rather than cycling from t = 0. Before the switch day the flagged cells are indistinguishable from the main population, so the compartment contributes no early writing and the arm bounds the mechanism from the correct side.

gliogenesis.description: a slowly cycling compartment with net-positive proliferation, standing in for astrocyte precursors and OPCs. The compartment cycles throughout rather than switching on at the gliogenic transition, which the model cannot express; it therefore writes early as well as late and understates how far a purely late glial wave would blunt the gradient.

fate_heterogeneity.description: per-lineage spread on the fate-switch midpoint, standing in for regional heterogeneity between domains on different schedules.

confound_decomposition.description: recorded signal = true susceptibility x per-epoch recording probability. The second factor is the writable window.

sensitivity_2d.description: early-to-late gradient over a grid of writing rate and fate-switch midpoint, the two parameters section 2.7 ranks highest. residual_after_rank1 is the share of variance about the mean that a separable (non-interacting) surface leaves unexplained.

time_coupled.description: the same model with writing moved off division entirely. The per-day rate applies to post-mitotic cells, so this writer records after cycle exit rather than at division; it is not the polymerase ticker tape of the Fisher-information analyses, which writes in every cell regardless of cycle state and which this model cannot express. It isolates the coupling: population, schedule and readout are unchanged and only the event that triggers a write differs.

ticker_tape.description: writing at a constant rate per unit time in every cell, cycling or not, which is the regime the Fisher-information analyses of a polymerase ticker tape assume. Each terminal lineage occupies exactly one cell at every instant, so the expected number of ancestral write opportunities inside a window of fixed width is the same at every epoch and the gradient is 1 by construction. This is the benchmark the division-coupled 5.28 should be read against.

no_exit_null.description: every division keeps both daughters cycling and the cycle never lengthens, so nothing leaves the cycle. The population grows exponentially and every terminal lineage passes through the same number of divisions in any window, so both trends that produce front-loading vanish. This is the null the figure 2 axis draws at 1 and which no mechanism arm reaches.

observed.source: Yu Q, Kim H, Seidel S, et al. In vivo reconstruction of the cell lineage history of a developing mouse with DNA Typewriter, from zygote to late organogenesis. bioRxiv 2026. doi:10.64898/2026.07.29.741625 (PMC13484211)

mouse_validation.divisions_plausible_note: A mouse embryo at E13.5 carries of order 1e7 to 1e8 cells, so a terminal lineage has undergone at least log2(1e7) = 23 divisions; asynchrony and cell loss raise the mean above that bound.
mouse_validation.verdict: At the HEK293T-anchored writing rate the model reaches the observed 55 of 66 sites after 32 divisions, inside the 23 to 34 divisions mouse embryology allows between the zygote and E13.5.
mouse_validation.note: Nothing is fitted. q is held at the value anchored to HEK293T in Table S1 and the only mouse-specific input is the division count, which is bounded below by the cell number at E13.5. The population model of section 4.1 is not used: occupancy depends on the population only through the division count, so this tests the recording module alone.

_provenance.order: the simulation scripts must run in the order listed; they merge into one file and later scripts overwrite keys earlier ones wrote. multiplicity.py, interaction_test.py and mouse_validation.py are post-processing and read the file rather than simulating.

overwritten_keys.writable.gradient, writable.per_epoch_re: run_all.py writes 3-population values; run_nondiv.py overwrites them with the 50-population values the manuscript quotes
overwritten_keys.multiplicity: rewritten whenever the arm family changes; the family is now the fourteen arms figure 2 draws
